preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input text.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == T + 1 and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: The input consists of T+1 lines where the first line is an integer T and the subsequent T lines are strings S.
The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100000 for s in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each string S has a length N between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The sum of lengths of all strings S across test cases does not exceed 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s) for s in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each string S consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and 0 <= int(line) < 1000000007 for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer between 0 and 10^9+6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((sum((len(sub) ** len(set(sub))) % 1000000007 for sub in distinct_substrings(s)) % 1000000007) == int(stdout_lines[i]) for i, s in enumerate(lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is the sum of F(P) for all distinct substrings P of S, modulo 10^9+7, where F(P) = (length(P) ^ distinct(P)) % (10^9+7).
